title: 2 Things You Didn't Know About the New Corvette ZR1
description:
The new Corvette ZR1 makes one thousand, sixty-four horsepower. It costs about as much as a well-equipped luxury S U V. And its name was once so rare that, in three years, only fifty-three buyers ticked the box. Here are two things you may not know about the Corvette ZR1: who really built the engine of the first one, and what that name has meant, generation by generation. One: the first ZR-1 engine was designed by Lotus and assembled by a company that mostly builds boat engines. Two: the ZR1 name started as a rare engine package, and each generation since has claimed to be the fastest Corvette of its day. We will follow the numbers across five decades, and say where our sources disagree.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
